text: The Galois group Gal(K/F) of a field extension K/F is:
choices: the group of ring homomorphisms K→K
the group of F-algebra automorphisms of K
the group of field extensions between F and K
explanation: Gal(K/F) is the group of field automorphisms σ:K→K fixing F pointwise. Its order equals [K:F] for Galois extensions.
